Modern, lightweight, and instantly recognizable. The FN Five-seveN is a Belgian semi-automatic pistol designed by FN Herstal, chambered for the distinctive 5.7×28 mm cartridge.
Now you can explore its inner workings – disassemble it, clean it, repair it, put it back together, and of course, test the results of your work at the shooting range.
It’s time for a true classic. The Colt Python is one of the most iconic American revolvers, produced since the mid-1950s and renowned for both its distinctive design and exceptional craftsmanship.

In Gunsmith Simulator, the Python is available in 4 different configurations, featuring barrel lengths ranging from a compact 2.5" all the way up to 8". This gives you the opportunity to explore several variants of this legendary design and see how its appearance changes depending on the configuration.
Two new guns, new parts to discover, and more firearm designs to master. The update is completely free for all Gunsmith Simulator owners!
Let us know which of the new guns will be the first to hit your workshop – the FN Five-seveN or the Colt Python?
You can also grab individual DLCs in bundles with the base game for even bigger savings.
Finally, we want to hear your feedback! Let us know what you think about the latest update, whether you’ve encountered any bugs, and what you’d like to see in Gunsmith Simulator in the future.
Thank you for being with us and helping us continue to improve Gunsmith Simulator. Have fun, and we’ll see you in the workshop, Gunsmiths!

releases.displayName: COVERT OPS UPDATE IS LIVE - STEN & WELROD!

items.text: We're proud to introduce our latest Update 1.5: Covert Ops - bringing two iconic weapons straight from the shadows of World War II into your workshop.

The Sten MK II is one of the most recognizable British submachine guns of WWII - a weapon born out of necessity, designed for mass production and reliability in harsh conditions. Its minimalist construction made it cheap and fast to manufacture, but in the right hands, it became a devastating tool.
Used extensively by British commandos and resistance fighters across occupied Europe, the Sten was a symbol of unconventional warfare.
In this update, you'll be able to explore the gun in detail, including two different stock variants, as well as a suppressor configuration that transforms it into a true covert operations tool.

The Welrod MK II is one of the most unusual firearms ever created. Developed for the British Special Operations Executive (SOE), this bolt-action, integrally suppressed pistol was purpose-built for stealth missions behind enemy lines.
With its near-silent operation and minimalist design, the Welrod became the weapon of choice for agents and commandos carrying out covert assassinations and sabotage missions.

notes.title: Step Into the World of Covert Warfare

items.text: This update is all about precision, silence, and history. Both weapons represent a completely different philosophy of firearm design - where subtlety mattered more than firepower.
Take them apart. Learn how they worked. And bring these legendary tools back to life in your workshop.

Heavy Metal DLC is on the horizon - featuring some of the most powerful machine guns ever created. If you haven't yet, make sure to add it to your wishlist and stay tuned.

items.text: We’ve prepared something special for you - a brand new update that adds three iconic firearms to your workshop, as well as a new encyclopedia feature to explore. And to celebrate, we're launching some serious discounts!
The AS VAL is a suppressed assault rifle developed for special forces operations.
It’s known for its high rate of fire and compact design.
In-game, you’ll get to explore its unique internal mechanics in full detail during disassembly and reassembly.
The VSS is the sniper variant of the AS VAL, also equipped with an integrated suppressor and optimized for stealth and precision.
Used by elite units, it’s prized for its silent operation and accuracy.
In Gunsmith Simulator, you’ll experience the intricate assembly of its optics and magazine system.
The P90 is a futuristic Belgian design known for its distinctive top-mounted magazine and compact frame.
Designed for fast engagement and mobility, it’s a favorite among counter-terrorist units.
This firearm brings a whole new level of challenge, with many small, detailed parts perfect for expert-level gunsmiths.
We’ve added a new encyclopedia to your workshop. It lets you browse detailed information about every unlocked gun.
Take a look, explore the history and mechanics-and let us know what you think on Discord. We’re eager to hear your feedback and ideas for improvement.

releases.displayName: THE NEW UPDATE FOR GUNSMITH SIMULATOR: ANTIQUES IS NOW AVAILABLE!

items.text: Dear Gunsmiths,

We’ve got some exciting news for you! We’ve just released a brand-new update for Gunsmith Simulator – Antiques! Along with it comes the premiere DLC Flint & Powder, which will let you explore the secrets of antique firearms. It’s time to dive into the fascinating world of historical treasures and unique challenges!

This update introduces a division between replicas and antiques. Replicas are guns that look like the original but are entirely made of new parts, while antiques are true treasures – firearms that are at least 100 years old, made entirely of original components, and have museum-level value. Antique guns will be much more expensive but also significantly harder to repair – a real treat for collectors and history buffs!

As part of this update, we’ve also introduced a new tool – the bench grinder. This machine allows for more delicate work with metals, preserving the integrity of antique weapon components. With it, you can restore these precious artifacts without risking damage.

Another new feature is wood waxing. This excellent method helps preserve old wood and draws inspiration from techniques used by gunsmiths of the past. With this option, your work will gain authentic character and timeless appeal.
We hope these new features will make your adventure with Gunsmith Simulator even more exciting. We encourage you to grab the Flint & Powder DLC and immerse yourself in the world of antique firearms!
Best regards,
The GameHunters Team

releases.displayName: UPDATE: NEW WEAPON, LEADERBOARDS, AND MUCH MORE!

items.text: Hello again, Gunsmiths!

We’re back with another exciting update that’s sure to delight every one of you! We've just released the latest update for our game, Gunsmith Simulator! What’s new, you ask? We’ve added a new weapon, leaderboards, expanded attachments, and the ability to paint them. Check out our video to see all the new features in action!
Now for the details!

One of the new additions is the introduction of a new weapon model – the Ruger Precision Rifle, the first modern sniper rifle implemented in our game. This model, introduced to the market in 2015, quickly gained recognition among sport shooters and hunters for its precision and versatility. The Ruger Precision Rifle allows easy barrel replacement and the use of various magazine types, making it incredibly versatile. Now you can try out its capabilities in our game.

Another new feature is the leaderboards, which are online tables that will allow you to compete with other players in mini-games. They will let you see how fast, agile, and accurate you are compared to others. You’ll compete in various shooting contests and in assembling and disassembling your weapons as quickly as possible. Remember, though, that every mistake made during disassembly will result in penalties in the form of additional time!

You’ll also be pleased with the expanded attachments. You can now slide attachments along rails and place them wherever you want. The exception is optics, which must be mounted on a thread or rail according to its mount. Additionally, you can now paint them just like your weapon!
From now on, the game will also allow you to remove parts of the weapon while working on it, giving you even more freedom to modify your equipment!
Share your impressions of the latest update. We look forward to your comments and feedback on our Discord!
We wish you lots of fun in our workshop and look forward to hearing from you in the next updates!

releases.displayName: UPDATE! NEW WEAPONS AND MUCH MORE!

items.text: Hey, Gunsmiths!

We have fantastic news for you - the latest update for Gunsmith Simulator has just landed! So what's in it? Well, we've prepared two brand new weapons for you to add to your collection, optics adjustment mechanics, and time challenges to further intensify your gaming experience.

The first of the new additions is the legendary STG 44 - the German automatic rifle known from the World War II period, which made its debut in 1943. This exceptional weapon is one of the pioneers among intermediate cartridge automatic rifles introduced into armament.

The second new weapon we're adding to the game is the reliable MAC-10, also known as the Ingram M10. This American submachine gun from the 1960s is a symbol of rapid fire and versatility, popular both among law enforcement agencies and criminal circles.

Another element of this update will be the optics adjustment mechanics to improve the accuracy of your weapons. When you buy a scope or red dot sight for your weapon, bullets won't perfectly hit the designated spot. In the workshop, you'll be able to use a laser device for preliminary adjustment (boresight), and then, at the shooting range, adjust the sight settings (sighting-in) by shooting at targets and adjusting the optics.

We've also prepared a special task, which is a perfect opportunity to demonstrate precision and speed! You'll face a challenge where you can test your skills in weapon assembly and disassembly against the clock.

And that's not all! Now you have the chance to get the game with a 30% discount - it's the biggest price drop we've had so far! Don't hesitate - the offer will only last for two weeks, so take advantage of it while you can!
Let us know how you like our latest update. We're waiting for your opinions and feedback on our Discord!
Enjoy the game and stay tuned for more exciting news soon!
